title: Sectionwise condensed pushforward continuity

from.place: Proof steps 1-5, ending with the comparison on one affine weakly contractible target object

statement: Let Λ be a condensed commutative ring, let f : X → Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes, and let D be a filtered diagram of cochain complexes of internal Λ_X-module sheaves on the pro-etale site of X. Assume an integer a satisfies H^n(D_i) = 0 for every i and every n < a. Put E_i = τ_{≥a} D_i and let E be their termwise colimit. For every integer q and every affine pro-etale Y-object V whose evaluation on set-valued sheaves takes epimorphisms to surjections, the component at V of the underlying abelian-sheaf map colim_i H^q(Rf_* QD_i) → H^q(Rf_* QE) is an isomorphism of abelian groups. Here Q is localization to the derived category, and the map is the universal colimit map with legs obtained by applying H^q Rf_* Q to D_i → E_i → E. The conclusion concerns one evaluation of this comparison.

source.place: Lemma 5.3(1), its proof by w-contractible affine hypercovers, and the first paragraph of the proof explaining derived global sections; translated to strict bounded-below diagrams and their termwise sheaf colimits.

proof.text: Good truncation at the common cohomological lower bound is an objectwise quasi-isomorphism. Its termwise colimit is still strictly bounded below, because evaluation preserves colimits and colimits of zero objects are zero. Lift this diagram and cocone to bounded-below complexes.
The inverse image of affine V is qcqs by base-change stability of quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness. Choose its affine weakly contractible hypercover.
Abelian section evaluation at V preserves colimits. The total hypercover section functor preserves colimits, and filtered abelian-group colimits commute with homology.

Transport the bounded-below total colimit cocone through the natural hypercover comparison. Precompose by the objectwise invertible good-truncation maps. The resulting evaluated original cocone is a colimit cocone. The universal comparison between it and the evaluated canonical colimit cocone is exactly the map in the theorem, hence is invertible.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09A2 and 0946; Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach, Constructible sheaves, Lemma 5.3(1); G2 generic cocone argument and abelian-section total

theorem condensed_qcqs_pushforward_local_comparison
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj Λ X)) ℤ)
    (a : ℤ) (ha : ∀ (i : I) (n : ℤ), n < a → IsZero ((D.obj i).homology n))
    (q : ℤ) (V : Y.ProEt) (hV : IsAffine V.left)
    (hweak : ∀ (F G : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (Type (u + 1))) (g : F ⟶ G),
      Epi g → Function.Surjective (g.hom.app (op V))) :
    IsIso (((Mod.forget (condensedRingObj Λ Y)).map
      (colimit.desc
        (D ⋙ (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ f).rightDerivedFunctor ⋙
          DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q))
        ((DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ f).rightDerivedFunctor ⋙
          DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).mapCocone
          ((Cocone.precompose (Functor.whiskerLeft D
            ((ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE a).πTruncGENatTrans _))).obj
              (colimit.cocone
                (D ⋙ (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE a).truncGEFunctor _)))))).hom.app
                  (op V))
